mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing @ChargeDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Xin Zhao grants himself @f1@% (%i:scaleAS%%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.

This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing @ChargeDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Xin Zhao grants himself @f1@% = (@ASMod*100@% +1% per @PermanentASToASRatio@% Permanent %i:scaleAS% +@APToASRatio*10000@% per 100%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.

This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Audacious Charge</titleLeft><mainText>Xin Zhao has increased Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every third Attack or strike with <spellName>Wind Becomes Lightning</spellName> deals an additional <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and restores <healing>@TotalHealing@ Health</healing>.

mBuff.mDescription: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Three Talon Strike</titleLeft><mainText>Xin Zhao's next three attacks deal bonus damage. His third attack also knocks his opponent into the air.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional @BonusDamage@ physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for @KnockUpDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Three Talon Strike</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been knocked into the air by Xin Zhao.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals @TotalDamage@ plus @PercentCurrentHealthDamage*100@% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies.

Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for @MissileDefenseBaseDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals a max of <physicalDamage>600 damage</physicalDamage> to jungle monsters and minions.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Awareness</titleLeft><mainText>Xin Zhao has extremely elevated awareness and will completely avoid damage from attackers that are far enough away.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Xin Zhao slashes, dealing @SlashDamage@ physical damage, then thrusts, dealing @ThrustDamage@. Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by @Effect6Amount*-100@% for @TotalSlowDuration@ seconds.

Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for @MarkDuration@ seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The thrust's damage is increased by up to @CritChanceAmp*100@% based on Xin Zhao's Critical Strike Chance.
Deals @MinionMod@% damage to minions.
Applies Lifesteal at 33% effectiveness on both attacks.
